transcoder_policy: Production resolves the required plugin-owned SageTVTranscoder bridge. Stock SageTV ffmpeg is never selected directly or replaced. Explicit overrides are retained only for isolated tests and diagnostics.
p14_phase_boundary: P14 adds bounded/redacted support diagnostics, a reversible current-video test, browser-saved-default profiles, and administrator-mounted server diagnostic destinations without changing stock SageTV server/JAR behavior.
report_policy: Support reports are ZIP bundles with redacted browser/native/HLS/transcoder state, hashes and bounded logs/counters. Subtitle/caption payload text, credentials and browser client identity are excluded.
profile_policy: Import/export is limited to schema-versioned browser-saved defaults. Native client identity, per-session PID/page/track choices and administrator server settings are outside profile scope.
diagnostic_destination_policy: Server writes are disabled by default and can target only the administrator-configured JVM mounted directory. The browser receives status/basename only and never SMB credentials or arbitrary server paths. Failed external saves may use a bounded plugin-owned local spool with explicit retry.
video_test_policy: Test Current Video records cadence/buffer state and, only for safe long non-DVD media, performs pause/resume plus a small reversible seek while restoring playback/audio state. Interrupted restoration may seek only when the recording identity still matches.
p14_field_gates: WP14-006 exercise an administrator-mounted real server destination, force a write failure into the bounded spool, restore the destination, retry, and inspect the exported ZIP for redaction
next_task: Complete WEB-014/WP16-004 with an indexed authored DVD fixture: root/submenus, stills, SPU highlight/navigation, title/chapter/audio/subtitle changes, fallback, Stop/replay, and teardown.
validation_boundary: Local/generated suites pass. Live .232 commissioning proves plugin-owned transcoder discovery, QSV gates, real vendor playback, ATSC MPEG-2/AC-3 with CEA and seek, UK H.264/AC-3 Teletext and DVB bitmap, and redacted/hash-verified report export. No indexed H.265/file-subtitle fixture or active growing recording was available, and the full physical/authored DVD SPU/menu matrix remains open.
p14_codec_test: Native-HLS-only synthetic A/B/C controls plus D/E real-parameter fixture. D/E use one MPEG-2 Main 1280x720 progressive 60000/1001 source with ~6.3 Mb/s video, English AC-3 5.1 384 kb/s and Spanish AC-3 stereo 192 kb/s. D copies video and converts selected audio to AAC stereo; E transcodes video to H.264 while preserving 1280x720p59.94.
mpeg2_copy_policy: Explicit videoMode=copy attempts FFmpeg video stream-copy for the source video codec without a codec allow-list, including when ffprobe metadata is unavailable. Auto remains conservative. Source resolution/FPS and no forced deinterlace are required.
mpeg2_copy_fallback: With allowFallback=true, any explicit HLS Copy session whose timeline advances but browser video dimensions remain 0x0 after startup may restart once at the same position as H.264.
copy_selection_fix: Video processing persists immediately. v3.2.21 also removes the normal-player codec allow-list for explicit Copy so it reaches the same FFmpeg stream-copy attempt exercised by the codec-test page.
probe_policy: Try ffprobe first (configured override, FFmpeg sibling, then PATH). If ffprobe cannot start, exits unsuccessfully, or returns no tracks, use the configured FFmpeg executable for a bounded input probe and parse source stream metadata. Diagnostics expose source.probeMethod=ffprobe|ffmpeg.
mpeg2_transcode_cadence_policy: Source resolution/FPS remain unchanged on compatibility fallback. Deinterlace Auto inserts yadif only when the probed source is interlaced; progressive 720p59.94 bypasses deinterlacing. One-second GOP derives from source cadence (ceil 59.94 = 60).
hardware_transcode_policy: All GPU backends attempt hardware decode + hardware encode first. NVIDIA/QSV/VAAPI also attempt hardware VPP when the real initialization probe succeeds. Startup fallback order is full hardware -> hardware encode with software decode/filters -> libx264.
stv_caption_control_policy: In STV/SageTV authority mode, VIDEO_CC_STATE is the control plane while the web client renders CEA-608 through the proven browser-local caption decoder. State 0 disables/clears captions; states 1..4 select CC1..CC4. If the property is absent, CC1 remains the compatibility fallback.
native_dvd_role_policy: Completed native DVD role is enabled by default. INPUT_DEVICES omits MOUSE and PUSH_AV_CONTAINERS advertises MPEG2-PS so stock SageTV selects MiniDVDPlayer. Set -Dsagetv.webplayer.nativeDvdProtocol=false only to restore the ordinary browser role for troubleshooting.
dvd_transcode_policy: Native DVD-Video is always converted from stock MiniDVDPlayer MPEG-PS to browser-compatible H.264/AAC HLS. Hardware decode input options are emitted before -i pipe:0; the browser-selected encoder is preserved, but ordinary-media Copy never applies to DVD.
dvd_field_failure_fix: 3.2.27 fixed DVD hardware FFmpeg input-option ordering. 3.2.28 retained authored DVD menu frames. 3.2.29 adds DVD startup recovery: full hardware -> hardware encode/software decode+filters -> libx264, with a bounded 16 MiB MPEG-PS replay prefix so a failed startup stage cannot consume the title/menu cell before retry.
dvd_menu_frame_policy: Browser caches decoded DVD frames by native DVD generation. FLUSH/freeze promotes only a proven cached frame; cache misses retain the prior menu still instead of painting black. The still is released only after a decoded frame from the replacement generation is observed.
